definition: a spell of very hot weather for days
description: On a city street on a very hot evening, a young woman in a white blouse and dark pencil skirt stands barefoot on wet cobblestones holding her black shoes, while cool spray from a burst water pipe showers over the crowd and makes a rainbow. She opens her mouth, throws her arms wide and laughs up into the water. Office workers in suits with briefcases stand around her in the mist, a dog lies on the wet pavement and rolls onto its back, and a red double-decker bus waits behind in the golden low sun.

en.question: What is the barefoot woman doing?

de.answer: Sie breitet die Arme weit aus.
